title: InstallPreferencesRequest
description:
Request for `install_preferences`: which scope's saved preference to
read. Defaults to the global root, so a caller that only ever installs
globally sends nothing.

scope.description:
`Global` reads the scope home's preference; `Project` reads one
project's.

ProjectRef.description:
Absolute path of a tracked project directory.

Invariant: the path is canonical inside a [`crate::scope::NormalizedScope`].
Wire values are the lexical path the caller gave.
